publicLayouts.name: Vitrine
publicLayouts.prompt:
Make a portfolio website fit for the victorian era, romantic era 1800s vibes. I would like fancy borders, museum like atmosphere..

Design direction:
Make something that feels like: browseable field + diagrammatic.
Use these as starting points: Dream Pages + Quilt.
Other cues:
- Visible to Friction: browseable field
- Abstract to Skeuomorphic: diagrammatic

Design clarification answers:
- Which Victorian metaphor best anchors how work is displayed across the browseable field?
  Answer: Cabinet of Curiosities
  Rationale: Works arranged as labelled specimens in a flat vitrine grid — diagrammatic, scannable, each piece a classified object
- How do the Victorian borders and ornament behave across the diagrammatic field?
  Answer: Gilt frame corners only
  Rationale: Decorative corner flourishes mark each specimen card; field stays open and scannable
- How does the visitor move through the cabinet — what organises the specimen field?
  Answer: Folded index at the edge
  Rationale: A pull-out classified index panel lets visitors jump to any specimen directly

publicLayouts.name: Zine Folk
publicLayouts.prompt:
Generate from image.

Image-derived design contract:
REFERENCE_FIDELITY: high
Use the uploaded image as a style reference, not a literal scene copy.
Preserve the visual language, palette, texture, material system, composition density, motif vocabulary, and interaction mood. Generalize specific objects/text into reusable portfolio components.
Do not collapse the image into a generic existing metaphor. The generated interface should visibly inherit the reference image in the first viewport.
Summary: Playful and artistic portfolio with hand-drawn illustration and vintage graphic style
Keywords: illustration, graphic design, portfolio
Visual style: flat colors with muted pastel palette, bold black outlines, hand-drawn organic shapes, retro typography
Material system: digital illustration, vector graphics, text blocks with varied font weights
Layout contract background: light beige with subtle texture
Layout contract density: medium, balanced whitespace and content
Layout contract composition: top header with large title, two-column content below
Required motifs: hand-drawn flowers and stars, hand gestures holding sign, illustrated character sitting with sneakers, decorative underline and bullet shapes
Required materials: flat pastel color fills, black line art, serif and sans-serif font pairing, rounded rectangular badges for skills and interests
Forbidden simplifications: removing hand-drawn line quality, using solid bright colors instead of muted pastels, omitting decorative stars and floral elements
Mood: friendly, creative, inviting
Typography personality: friendly, modern, artistic
Layout composition: header with centered title and decorative elements, two columns below with illustration left and text right
Layout texture: subtle paper-like background texture
Must preserve: hand-drawn illustration style, decorative floral and star motifs, typographic hierarchy
Motif vocabulary: hand-drawn flowers, stars, peace and rock hand gestures, sneakers, rounded badges
Components: header with hand-drawn title and floral decorations, navigation bar with minimal text links, illustrated character block, text content blocks with headings and paragraphs, skill badges, contact info with icons
Interface components: illustration panel, text description panel, skills badges, contact icons
Interface metaphor: handcrafted artistic portfolio as a personal showcase
Navigation: simple horizontal text links below header
Motion: minimal or no animation
Interaction pace: calm and steady
Generator brief: Create a playful and artistic portfolio website featuring a hand-drawn style with muted pastel colors and bold black outlines. The header includes a large, vintage-inspired typographic title held by illustrated hands with floral decorations. Below, present a two-column layout with a friendly illustrated self-portrait on the left and descriptive text on the right. Include skill badges with rounded edges and a minimal navigation bar. Maintain a warm beige textured background and preserve hand-drawn decorative motifs for a creative, inviting vibe.

Design clarification answers:
- What feeling should the illustrated self-portrait character most radiate?
  Answer: Playful & curious
  Rationale: Character leans forward with wide eyes, suggesting wonder and mischief.
- How should the skill badges and decorative motifs fill the space around the text content?
  Answer: Layered & abundant
  Rationale: Motifs overlap text edges and badges stack in rows, creating a richly decorated zine feel.
- How should the navigation links feel within the overall handcrafted aesthetic?
  Answer: Minimal & typographic
  Rationale: Clean serif/sans mix, understated, letting illustrations dominate without nav competing.

publicLayouts.examplePrompt:
Generate from image.

Image-derived design contract:
REFERENCE_FIDELITY: high
Use the uploaded image as a style reference, not a literal scene copy.
Preserve the visual language, palette, texture, material system, composition density, motif vocabulary, and interaction mood. Generalize specific objects/text into reusable portfolio components.
Do not collapse the image into a generic existing metaphor. The generated interface should visibly inherit the reference image in the first viewport.
Summary: Playful and artistic portfolio with hand-drawn illustration and vintage graphic style
Keywords: illustration, graphic design, portfolio
Visual style: flat colors with muted pastel palette, bold black outlines, hand-drawn organic shapes, retro typography
Material system: digital illustration, vector graphics, text blocks with varied font weights
Layout contract background: light beige with subtle texture
Layout contract density: medium, balanced whitespace and content
Layout contract composition: top header with large title, two-column content below
Required motifs: hand-drawn flowers and stars, hand gestures holding sign, illustrated character sitting with sneakers, decorative underline and bullet shapes
Required materials: flat pastel color fills, black line art, serif and sans-serif font pairing, rounded rectangular badges for skills and interests
Forbidden simplifications: removing hand-drawn line quality, using solid bright colors instead of muted pastels, omitting decorative stars and floral elements
Mood: friendly, creative, inviting
Typography personality: friendly, modern, artistic
Layout composition: header with centered title and decorative elements, two columns below with illustration left and text right
Layout texture: subtle paper-like background texture
Must preserve: hand-drawn illustration style, decorative floral and star motifs, typographic hierarchy
Motif vocabulary: hand-drawn flowers, stars, peace and rock hand gestures, sneakers, rounded badges
Components: header with hand-drawn title and floral decorations, navigation bar with minimal text links, illustrated character block, text content blocks with headings and paragraphs, skill badges, contact info with icons
Interface components: illustration panel, text description panel, skills badges, contact icons
Interface metaphor: handcrafted artistic portfolio as a personal showcase
Navigation: simple horizontal text links below header
Motion: minimal or no animation
Interaction pace: calm and steady
Generator brief: Create a playful and artistic portfolio website featuring a hand-drawn style with muted pastel colors and bold black outlines. The header includes a large, vintage-inspired typographic title held by illustrated hands with floral decorations. Below, present a two-column layout with a friendly illustrated self-portrait on the left and descriptive text on the right. Include skill badges with rounded edges and a minimal navigation bar. Maintain a warm beige textured background and preserve hand-drawn decorative motifs for a creative, inviting vibe.

Design clarification answers:
- What feeling should the illustrated self-portrait character most radiate?
  Answer: Playful & curious
  Rationale: Character leans forward with wide eyes, suggesting wonder and mischief.
- How should the skill badges and decorative motifs fill the space around the text content?
  Answer: Layered & abundant
  Rationale: Motifs overlap text edges and badges stack in rows, creating a richly decorated zine feel.
- How should the navigation links feel within the overall handcrafted aesthetic?
  Answer: Minimal & typographic
  Rationale: Clean serif/sans mix, understated, letting illustrations dominate without nav competing.
